in_sanskrit.name: काञ्चन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is as golden as the sun or moon

in_marathi.name: Kaanchan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kaanchan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kancana’ meaning ‘golden’. In Hindu mythology, Kaanchan refers to Lord Vishnu who is often depicted as having golden skin.

in_bengali.name: Kaanchan
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kaanchan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kancana’ meaning ‘golden’. In Hindu mythology, Kaanchan refers to Lord Vishnu who is often depicted as having golden skin.
